title: Dimensional Rift
next_chapter_hook: That gaze did not dissipate, instead slowly opening in the depths of the sky, like an eye that had slumbered for billions of years finally awakening—the life and death struggles of the three-dimensional world were merely another set of data in its lengthy experiment.

text.content:
Just as Chen Ji was nearly crushed by the truth, Su Qingyao's voice rang out again, light as a feather falling into an abyss—

"Chen Ji, look up."

Instinctively, he raised his head, then froze in place.

The sky, had cracked.

Not the ordinary kind of lightning strike, nor the spiritual energy fluctuation torn open by cultivators dueling. Instead, it was a wound extending from the depths of the universe—dark, profound, carrying a pressure beyond all comprehension. The rift stretched across the skies of the Three Realms, its length unknown for tens of thousands of miles, its width immeasurable, as if someone had, with brushstrokes surpassing the Heavenly Dao, fiercely slashed a gash across the paper of the heavens.

"What... what is this thing?" For the first time, a tremor entered Su Qingyao's voice.

Chen Ji offered no answer. His Tianji Record was vibrating frantically, the runes on the fragment almost igniting, yet the content displayed was entirely chaotic—not vague, but completely blank.

The Tianji Record had never failed before.

Even when facing the machinations of the Heavenly Eye, he could peer through the cracks. But now, that force was like an ant attempting to observe human thought—absurdly laughable.

"Higher... dimensions." Chen Ji murmured to himself, his pupils constracting sharply, "It's a being from a higher dimension."

dialogue.content:
On the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul abruptly manifested, his voice carrying terror for the first time: "Impossible... how could the Dimensional Invader awaken so quickly? According to the original timeline, there should have been at least three hundred more years—"

He abruptly stopped, as if realizing he had revealed something.

But Chen Ji had no time to pursue the question.

Because from that rift, something was "observing" this world.

text.content:
It was an indescribable form of "observation."

Not a gaze, not divine consciousness, not any form of perception a three-dimensional being could comprehend. Simply being "seen" itself caused cultivators at the edges of the Three Realms to be struck like by thunder—

Tens of thousands of cultivators vomited blood simultaneously.

On the border defense lines, among the dozens of Unity Realm powerhouses, seven had their souls directly disintegrated, not even having time to scream.

This was not an attack. This was a gaze.

Like a human bending down to observe bacteria in a petri dish, without even bothering to release any malice.

"Hahahaha!"

A wild laughter rang out from the depths of the rift, the voice exploding directly in the minds of all living beings across the Three Realms—regardless of cultivator or mortal, regardless of man or woman, old or young.

"This dilapidated three-dimensional world actually still has a few slightly stronger ants."

Before the laughter faded, a massive hand reached out from the rift.

That hand was composed of some substance beyond comprehension, and when its five fingers spread wide, it blotted out half the sky. Each finger was like a continuous mountain range. Most terrifying of all—it was four-dimensional.

A three-dimensional being's eyes could only perceive its projection in three-dimensional space, yet that projection alone made everyone's souls tremble.

The hand gently clenched.

On the border defense lines, three great cities turned to dust simultaneously.

Not collapse—direct erasure. The hundred thousand citizens, two thousand cultivators within those cities, along with their karmic connections, fates, and afterlives, were all completely obliterated within that single clench.

No screams, no vengeful spirits, no traces left behind.

As if they had never existed at all.

"This... this is impossible!" Su Qingyao's face turned deathly pale, "That was Tianxuan City! Tianxuan City with a Unity Realm Great One stationed there!"

Chen Ji remained silent, merely staring fixedly at that hand, his knuckles white from force.

dialogue.content:
"You three-dimensional creatures always love giving yourselves ridiculous names." That voice spoke again, carrying condescension and amusement from above, "Unity Realm? Unity of Heavenly Fate? Heh, merely playing some fancy tricks with three-dimensional world rules, yet you dare call yourselves 'unparalleled and amazing'?"

The hand flipped over, another clench.

Another great city vanished.

"You haven't even touched the edge of 'dimensions.' What you call the Heavenly Dao is merely a fence we erected in three-dimensional space, to prevent you ants from crawling out of the petri dish."

text.content:
Chen Ji froze solid.

The Heavenly Dao... was a fence?

He had schemed for years, calculating against the Heavenly Eye, thinking his opponent was the most terrifying existence in this world. But now, a higher-dimensional being casually told him: You thought the ceiling was the limit, but it was merely a circle I drew at will.

That feeling was like an ant thinking its nemesis was another ant colony, only to have an elephant step down, and the entire ant hill was gone.

The Tianji Record fragment burned frantically within him, Heavenly Fate Value depleting at an alarming rate—not for foresight, but to resist that crushing pressure.

"Chen Ji, your Heavenly Fate Value is plummeting!" Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out, "That pressure is corroding your foundation—you must retreat! With your current strength, you're no match at all!"

Chen Ji offered no answer.

He stared at that rift, at that wanton four-dimensional hand, at the beings of the Three Realms being crushed like ants.

Rage.

A kind of rage he hadn't felt in a long time.

Not hatred for the enemy, but hatred for his own powerlessness.

He had schemed his entire life, missing nothing, yet in the end, facing this kind of overwhelming force, what could he do?

text.content:
Chen Ji stomped forward abruptly, the Tianji Record fragment burning completely within his body, golden light erupting from all around him.

"Chen Ji! You're insane!" Su Qingyao cried out.

But she couldn't stop him.

Chen Ji's voice resounded across the Three Realms: "Dimensional Invader, do you think three-dimensional beings are mere ants?"

choices.visible_cost: Abandon the border of the Three Realms, endure the scorn

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth, grabbing Su Qingyao's wrist: "Go! To the Ancient Forbidden Land!"

Su Qingyao was shocked: "You're retreating? The Three Realms—"

"No time to explain!" Chen Ji roared, "A失利在即—"

Before he finished, that four-dimensional hand had already "looked" toward their location.

choices.description: Contact Ye Qing, Saint Maiden of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, borrow her Demonic Mist to conceal our aura, and attempt to negotiate with the dimensional invader.
choices.visible_cost: Owing Ye Qing a favor, possibly exposing the existence of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Buy precious time, possibly obtain crucial intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Will Ye Qing be willing to take the risk? Will the Eye of Heavenly Dao strike at this opportunity?

text.content: An acute gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he transmitted a thought to Ye Qing, far away in the demonic realm. A moment later, a wisp of black mist silently enveloped both Chen Ji and Su Qingyao. "Chen Ji, you've finally come to me." Ye Qing's voice echoed in his mind, "The dimensional invader... I sensed it too. What do you want to do?"

That four-dimensional palm hovered in mid-air, seemingly 'contemplating.' A moment later, that voice rang out again, carrying a playful smile: "Interesting. An ant slightly stronger than the rest, actually daring to jump about before me." The palm flicked lightly. An attack surpassing the speed of light struck toward Chen Ji—no, it couldn't even be called an attack, merely a instinctive rejection, like a human flicking away an annoying insect.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The Tianji Record auto-activated at the final moment, a burst of golden light erupting from within him, colliding with that attack. "BOOM!" He was blown flying thousands of miles, blood spurting from his mouth, his Heavenly Fate Value instantly depleted by over twenty points. Yet he didn't die. The owner of that palm seemed stunned: "Oh? There's something on you... somewhat familiar." For the first time, a hint of interest laced the voice. "The Tianji Record? I didn't expect this era's test subject to have collected that fragment to such an extent."

dialogue.content: The dimensional invader's voice suddenly carried a profound meaning: "Let me see... this fragment, did you inherit it from that three-dimensional ant called 'Chen Xuan'?" Chen Ji's entire body shuddered. Chen Xuan. That was his ancestor, the previous master of the Tianji Record. "What a pity, that ant had a bit of talent, once glimpsing the edges of dimensions." The voice said casually, "So we terminated his experimental process ahead of schedule. You three-dimensional beings always mistake accidentally glimpsing a corner for some grand truth."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his blood nearly solidify. Chen Xuan... was 'terminated'? That legendary ancestor, the predecessor who left behind the Tianji Record, the legend he always believed died peacefully of old age—was casually wiped out by a higher-dimensional existence? "Do you think you're rebelling against fate?" the voice continued, each word like a knife cutting into Chen Ji's heart, "Do you think your grand scheme across the world and meticulous planning constitute some了不起的成就?" Laughter rang out again, shaking the Three Realms. "Your fate was a experimental variable we set from the start. Your so-called 'rebellion' is nothing more than the wriggling of bacteria in a petri dish."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly straightened his body, wiping the blood from his lips, yet a smile actually curved his lips. "Experimental variables? Petri dish?" His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly entered the ears of every being in the Three Realms, "So what?"

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the surging rage in his heart, wearing a humble smile. "Elder is right, we three-dimensional beings truly are insignificant. I wonder what brings Elder to descend this time? This junior is willing to render any service." The voice seemed somewhat surprised, followed by laughter: "Oh? Knows when to bow to circumstances after all."

That four-dimensional palm slowly retracted, but the rift remained unclosed. The dimensional invader's voice rang out again, this time carrying the tone of an announcement: "Forget it, can't be bothered wasting more breath on you test subjects. Today was just a routine inspection,顺便收割一批数据." Its voice echoed across the Three Realms, each word like a brand seared into the souls of all beings. "Your fate as three-dimensional beings is merely test subjects for higher dimensions. We observe you, record you, and ultimately—annihilate you, starting the next round of experiments."

Chen Ji stared fixedly at that rift, his fingernails nearly embedding into his palms. His mind raced frantically: the other party said 'today is just an inspection,' said 'harvest data'—this means it can't destroy all beings at once? Is there some kind of restriction? Or deliberately toying? Furthermore, the other party showed interest in the Tianji Record yet only casually mentioned Chen Xuan... Mo Xiansheng said 'the original timeline still has three hundred years'—does this mean someone is manipulating the progression of time? Countless thoughts collided in Chen Ji's mind. Even in this desperate situation, his meticulous planning instinct continued operating. Yet that fury, like magma, churned in his chest.

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly looked up, his voice piercing through the Three Realms: "Senior, I have one more question—Is the Eye of Heavenly Secrets also your chess piece?"

From the depths of the crack came a soft laugh.

"Well asked." the voice said, "It is not a chess piece, it is... a system. A piece of code used to manage you experimental subjects."

choices.description: Remaining silent, deeply branding all of this into the depths of his soul—one day, he will personally end this experiment.
choices.visible_reward: Obtained hidden bonus: Foresight temporarily enhanced when confronting dimension-related entities
choices.risk_hint: The seed of hatred has been planted

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak a word, only quietly gazing at that crack.

His eyes were terrifyingly calm.

Su Qingyao stood beside him, feeling for the first time the bone-deep chill emanating from this man—not anger, but something more terrifying than anger.

It was holding grudges.

It was patience.

It was the fangs waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

That crack began to slowly heal.

The dimensional invader's voice sounded one last time, carrying a certain nonchalant declaration:

"By the way, I forgot to tell you all one thing—"

"This crack above the Three Realms will not disappear. Every so often, I will come to harvest a batch of data. You may call it... Divine Punishment."

Laughter echoed through the Three Realms.

"Struggle well, little ants. Your despair and struggle are my favorite experimental data."

The crack closed completely.

But that permanent dark spatial fissure remained in the heavens, like an eternally open eye, overlooking this Three Realms that had been sentenced to death.

The Three Realms fell silent.

Countless cultivators knelt on the ground, some weeping, some roaring, some已经完全崩溃 (completely broken).

They had cultivated their entire lives, pursuing the Heavenly Secrets, believing that sufficient power would allow them to transcend reincarnation. But today, all faith was crushed—

The so-called Heavenly Secrets were merely fences of beings from higher dimensions.

The so-called transcendence was merely the fantasy of bacteria in a petri dish.

And that permanent fissure in the sky was the guillotine hanging above everyone's head.

Su Qingyao looked at Chen Ji, her voice trembling: "Chen Ji... what should we do?"

Chen Ji did not answer.

He only stood there quietly, gazing at that fissure, his eyes terrifyingly deep.

After a long while, Chen Ji spoke.

His voice was soft, yet carried a terrifying certainty:

"It says we are experimental subjects, bacteria in a petri dish."

Chen Ji slowly turned, looking at the terrified, desperate, broken cultivators behind him.

"But it forgot one thing."

A slight smile curved at the corner of his mouth, that smile cold and sharp.

"Though small, bacteria can corrode steel. Though weak, ants can collapse dikes for miles."

"If Heaven wants to destroy me, I shall defy Heaven."

"If the dimensions want to harvest me—"

He raised his head,直视 (staring directly at) that never-healing fissure in the heavens, his eyes burning with fire that could incinerate everything.

"I shall—slaughter the divine."

Su Qingyao stared at this man before her.

He was covered in blood, in utter disarray, his Heavenly Fate almost depleted. But at this moment, he was more dazzling than anyone she had ever seen.

For the first time, she understood why the Tianji Record had chosen this person.

Not because of talent, not because of bloodline, but because of this heart that never surrendered and never forgot a grudge.

"Chen Ji." she called softly.

Chen Ji turned to look at her, the killing intent in his eyes dimming somewhat, replaced by a tenderness she had never seen before.

"Let's go." he said, "There is much to do."

Above the heavens, that fissure still gaped open, like eyes that had slumbered for billions of years finally opening—the survival or destruction of the three-dimensional world was merely another set of data in its long experiment.

But in this land of despair, there was one person whose eyes had already ignited the flames of rebellion.

This experiment... had only just begun.
